body:
WHAT
Every piece of text the engine sends to the model (system prompt sections, reminders, tool descriptions, side-call instructions, subagent roles) is declared once with `definePrompt` and given a stable id and group. There are 43 registered prompts in seven groups. A user can override any prompt by writing `<id>.txt` in the prompts directory; the file is re-read live (250 ms cache), so a change applies on the next turn without restart. An empty override switches the prompt off, and code that drives a model call uses `promptTextIfEnabled` so a disabled prompt cancels the call instead of sending a blank message. `orphanedPromptFiles` lists override files whose id no longer exists.

WHY
Without a registry, prompt text is scattered and cannot be listed or tuned, and an emptied prompt would silently send a blank instruction that costs a full model call and returns nonsense.

WHERE
engine/protocol/src/prompts.ts — `definePrompt()`, `promptText()`, `renderPrompt()`, `promptTextIfEnabled()`, `isPromptDisabled()`, `promptCatalog()`, `writePromptOverride()`, `clearPromptOverride()`, `orphanedPromptFiles()`, `promptsDir()` (env `MAGENTRA_PROMPTS_DIR`), `promptFile()`, `CACHE_TTL_MS`, `overrideText()`. Registrations: engine/core/src/agent/prompts.ts (group 1), engine/core/src/runtime/session.ts (groups 2, 3, 5), engine/core/src/runtime/finishing.ts (group 4), engine/core/src/agent/agents.ts (group 6), engine/core/src/agent/tool.ts and engine/protocol/src/prompts.ts (group 7), engine/core/src/runtime/engine.ts (`ADDON_AUTHOR_ROLE`), engine/core/src/agent/addons.ts. Disabled-prompt consumers: session.ts `promptTextIfEnabled(CLARIFY_SYSTEM)`, `isPromptDisabled(COMPACTION_SYSTEM)`, engine.ts `promptTextIfEnabled(ADDON_AUTHOR_ROLE)`, engine/tools/src/agent.ts and tool.ts `isPromptDisabled('tool.<name>')`.

TEST CHECKLIST
1. After importing the engine's core, tools and protocol modules, promptCatalog() has exactly 43 entries with unique ids, and the set of distinct `group` values has size 7.
2. With MAGENTRA_PROMPTS_DIR pointing at a temp dir, write '<id>.txt' with new text, wait > 250 ms, and assert promptText(id) returns the new text and promptCatalog() marks it overridden; delete the file and assert it returns to defaultText.
3. Write an empty '<id>.txt'; promptTextIfEnabled(id) returns undefined, isPromptDisabled(id) is true, and promptCatalog() marks disabled:true.
4. Using a FakeProvider, disable the compaction system prompt (empty override) and trigger /compact; assert the provider received no request and the user sees a notice instead of a blank-prompt call.
5. Create 'no.such.prompt.txt' in the prompts dir; orphanedPromptFiles() lists its absolute path and nothing else; writePromptOverride(id, defaultText) removes an existing override file rather than storing a copy; definePrompt with a duplicate id and different text throws.
